mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.policy_name, p.company_id, c.company_name, p.effective_date, p.expiry_date, p.content, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted FROM dbo.policy p LEFT JOIN dbo.company c ON p.company_id = c.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY p.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.policy(policy_name, company_id, effective_date, expiry_date, content) VALUES(#{policyName}, #{companyId}, #{effectiveDate}, #{expiryDate}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.policy SET policy_name=#{policyName}, company_id=#{companyId}, effective_date=#{effectiveDate}, expiry_date=#{expiryDate}, content=#{content}, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dbo.policy SET deleted=1, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT TOP (${limit}) p.id, p.policy_name, p.company_id, c.company_name, p.effective_date, p.expiry_date, p.content, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted FROM dbo.policy p LEFT JOIN dbo.company c ON p.company_id = c.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.effective_date DESC, p.id DESC
